entities.name: Linda Nosková
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Linda Nosková is a Czech professional tennis player. She has a career-high singles ranking of world No. 12 by the WTA, achieved on 5 January 2026, and a doubles ranking of No. 60, set on 19 August 2024. Nosková has won one WTA Tour title, at the 2024 Monterrey Open. Her best performance at the majors is reaching the quarterfinals at the 2024 Australian Open, defeating world No. 1 Iga Świątek en route. Nosková is currently the No. 1 women's singles player from Czechia.
